messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

The SIM card showing as "missing" is the root cause of your MMS issue. Without a SIM card, you won't have cellular service, and MMS requires cellular service to work.

Please run this on your phone to reseat the SIM card:
- **reseat_sim_card**

This will simulate removing and reinserting your SIM card to ensure it's correctly seated. After you've done that, let me know and we'll check your SIM status again.

I have reseated the SIM card as you instructed. The status bar now shows a poor signal with 2G network and data still disabled. What should I do next?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
